name: Concentrated range mean-reversion LP
hypothesis: Provide a predeclared concentrated range after stability and two-sided organic volume pass tests.
spec: Setup: A verified stationary price region may justify concentration. Entry: Provide a predeclared concentrated range after stability and two-sided organic volume pass tests. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Withdraw on range-break confirmation, risk cap, or deadline. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs AMM liquidity-position simulation (fees, ranges, impermanent loss)
